citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:13 PM on
03SEP2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by text message and telecommunication. Failure to provide
access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to
provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
